title: Technical CRM Specialist
description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

Our CRM team is growing. We’re looking for a Technical CRM Specialist to join our affiliate marketing business in London.

This is an opportunity for someone with some experience with either Adobe campaign or SFMC, as well as HTML, SQL queries, and JavaScript, to support the team in delivering a customer-centric, automated experience across email, SMS, and messaging channels.

In this role, you’ll be supporting the CRM Technical Manager as well as CRM team and its wider ecosystem, using tools such as SparkPost, Email on Acid, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SMS integrations, Adobe Campaign and Rebrandly.

title: Team Lead Data Products & Analytics (gn)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Mit der Bikeleasing Gruppe gestalten wir die Zukunft moderner Mobilität und Arbeitswelten. Als führende Unternehmensgruppe für Arbeitgeber-Benefits und Mobilitätslösungen vereinen wir fünf spezialisierte Unternehmen unter einem Dach – von Multi-Benefit-Anbietern über Leasing- und Versicherungsdienstleister bis hin zu Händlern für refurbished Bikes. Wir wachsen profitabel und befinden uns auf einer spannenden technischen Transformationsreise. Als Team Lead Data Products & Analytics (gn) hast Du maßgeblichen Einfluss darauf, wie wir Daten in echten Business-Mehrwert verwandeln. Du führst ein cross-funktionales Analytics-Team, baust die Team-Lead-Funktion von Grund auf auf und verbindest strategische Datenanforderungen mit operativer Exzellenz. Dich erwartet ein moderner Stack, direkte Linie zum Head of Data und gruppenweite Wirkung über Bikeleasing-Service, Probonio und Bike2Future. Wenn Du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, Dinge pragmatisch voranbringst und in einem professionellen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen arbeiten willst – dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

  • Du führst disziplinarisch und fachlich ein Team aus Analytics Engineers und Analysten und entwickelst jeden Einzelnen gezielt in seiner Karriere weiter
  • Du ownst den Team-Backlog: Du priorisierst Stakeholder-Anfragen, schützt Teamkapazität und kommunizierst Entscheidungen transparent nach außen
  • Qualität und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenprodukte treibst Du voran – von KPI-Definitionen und Self-Service-Dashboards über semantische Schichten bis hin zu AI-Produkten
  • Du baust schlanke Prozesse für Refinement, Planung und Delivery auf und hältst Overhead konsequent klein
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Head of Data und technischen Peers zusammen

title: Valuer Gold Loan
description:
Job Requirements

About the Role

The Valuer â Gold Loan plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of gold loan valuations across branches pan-India. This role involves assessing the purity and value of gold collateral, supporting disbursal processes, conducting audits, and training branch staff. The incumbent is expected to uphold the highest standards of ethics, confidentiality, and compliance while contributing to customer acquisition and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct gold loan valuations using standardized methods and tools.
  • Perform thorough checks to assess the purity of gold collateral.
  • Ensure timely disbursal of cases within defined turnaround times (TAT).
  • Visit nearby branches for stock audits and valuation activities.
  • Monitor delinquent cases and support branches in managing portfolio quality.
  • Deliver training sessions to branch staff on gold loan valuation and fraud awareness.
  • Maintain integrity and transparency in all transactions, avoiding any direct or indirect personal interest.
  • Conduct customer reference checks with sincerity and professionalism.
  • Uphold confidentiality of client information and ensure it is not shared with competitors.
  • Adhere strictly to company policies and ensure they are not disclosed outside the organization.
  • Safeguard company assets provided for job responsibilities.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth functioning of valuation processes.
  • Support marketing and customer engagement efforts as needed.
  • Participate in ad-hoc activities as required by the department.
